checked_obligation: Verify that the legal ten-21s construction failing for N=9 implies the necessary lower bound N≥10.
reason: By n8, a legal list has no subset sum in [191,209], so N=9 is not universally sufficient. For every positive integer N≤9, [200−N,200+N] is contained in [191,209], so the same list also defeats that N. Hence any winning value must satisfy N≥10.
